title: You Hear it When You Sleep Dont You

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Look who's wandered back to the hustle and bustle and rustle of the struggle. Oh, that's a good one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look who's wandered back to the hustle and bustle and rustle of the struggle. Oh, that's a good one.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Words are words, beats are heartbeats. The pulse. The life. The very blood of the vibes. Cut me open and you'll see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Words are words, beats are heartbeats. The pulse. The life. The very blood of the vibes. Cut me open and you'll see.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ahh, so here we are. Listen, if you listen - get it? No? Ah, it's subliminal verses trying to depict the worse... ening - ah, that one needs some massaging.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahh, so here we are. Listen, if you listen - get it? No? Ah, it's subliminal verses trying to depict the worse... ening - ah, that one needs some massaging.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Do you want to assist? To find the vibes and ride the waves with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you want to assist? To find the vibes and ride the waves with me?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Listen, everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, everything I know about finding the vibe came from one person, Mr. AG himself.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Mr. Anthony Geraci himself. The number one synth accordo to grace the airwaves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr. Anthony Geraci himself. The number one synth accordo to grace the airwaves.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Well, the secret is what he teaches through his music. See, the thing is, once you find the vibe that works for you, the rhythm your life flows by, everything else just exists. Once that happens it's, well it's golden.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, the secret is what he teaches through his music. See, the thing is, once you find the vibe that works for you, the rhythm your life flows by, everything else just exists. Once that happens it's, well it's golden.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Gotta hear the music. Feel the vibe the airwaves are putting out. Last I heard it, the time I realized yeah, this is where I need to be, was in the Port.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gotta hear the music. Feel the vibe the airwaves are putting out. Last I heard it, the time I realized yeah, this is where I need to be, was in the Port.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Sometimes the rhymes work sometimes they don't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes the rhymes work sometimes they don't.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Those ships coming in from Luna. The raw power of everything around me. Maybe it'll have the same effect on you too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those ships coming in from Luna. The raw power of everything around me. Maybe it'll have the same effect on you too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have a gift.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have a gift.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Need a beat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Need a beat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Forgot my knives at the restaurant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Forgot my knives at the restaurant.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Forgot my knives at the restaurant.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Forgot my knives at the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want to bleed like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to bleed like that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want to bleed like that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want to bleed like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're the lyricist. Good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're the lyricist. Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do I find them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do I find them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mr. AG?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr. AG?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never heard of him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never heard of him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And the secret?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the secret?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do I find it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do I find it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep an ear out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep an ear out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I have a choice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I have a choice?
